# Dynatrace Intelligence Overview

Core Functionality:
Dynatrace Intelligence uses "deterministic, causation-based analysis" across applications,
services, infrastructure, logs, and traces to detect anomalies and identify root causes
with topology context.

Key Capabilities:
The platform integrates the Grail data lakehouse and Smartscape dependency graph to
establish baselines and correlate code changes, deployments, and configuration updates.
It features agentic workflows with built-in agents operating under policy guardrails
(currently in Preview).

Primary Use Cases:
- Developers: Detect regressions linked to builds/feature flags; pinpoint root cause with
  code-level details
- SRE: Monitor Kubernetes/cloud with anomaly detection; map dependency impact and trigger
  approved runbooks
- Security: Triage vulnerabilities by risk and service context; initiate remediation
  workflows

Natural Language Support:
The system supports "in-context natural language for investigation and guided next steps,"
enabling teams to review findings, open tickets, notify owners, or execute vetted runbooks
within unified data context.

Getting Started Resources:
Documentation includes the Problems app for incident root cause analysis and the Anomaly
Detection app for configuration exploration.
